create_llm_wrapper: create a subclass of BaseLLM that implements generate and format_message for a specific LLM provider
implement_generate_method: implement the generate method in a BaseLLM subclass to call an LLM API with messages and temperature
implement_format_message_method: implement the format_message method in a BaseLLM subclass to format role and content into a message dict
review_Basellm_class: review the BaseLLM abstract base class and its generate and format_message abstract methods
refactor_llm_subclass: refactor an existing BaseLLM subclass to support additional parameters like max_output_tokens
